Title: Verify user can convert 1 ETH to TRX
Steps:
1. Initialize BVNK account and get bearer token
2. Get current ETH wallet balance
3. Get current TRX wallet balance
4. Create a quote to convert 1 ETH to TRX
5. Accept the quote
6. Wait for transaction to complete
7. Verify ETH balance decreased by 1 (+ service fee)
8. Verify TRX balance increased
Expected Results: Transaction completes successfully with correct balance changes

Title: Verify authentication via /echo endpoint
Steps:
1. Initialize BVNK account
2. Call /echo endpoint with test payload
3. Verify response contains token expiry
4. Verify echoed content matches request
Expected Results: Echo endpoint returns correct response with authentication working

Title: Verify API health check endpoint
Steps:
1. Call /health endpoint (no authentication)
2. Verify response status is 200
3. Verify response contains uptime
4. Verify response time is under 3 seconds
Expected Results: Health endpoint is accessible and responds quickly
